findings.summary: Zero-job cancelled shell of the curator pipeline itself: created 18:01:16Z by a workflow_run completion event, cancelled 18:01:20Z with jobs=[] — zero bytes distilled, zero tokens, nothing existed to lose. The backfill duty it would have started was fulfilled by later curator invocations (the very existence of post-18:01 records in evidence/run-memory/runs/ proves the pipeline recovered).

Parent-completion event and canceller both UNATTRIBUTABLE locally: the bundle carries no refs.txt content and no job logs (legitimately empty, jobs=0), and no second curator trigger is identifiable in fetched refs before 18:01:20Z (the next evidence-curator.yml push, d8343e7, came at 18:05:29Z — too late to explain it). Same-second co-creation with watchdog #78 (both 18:01:16Z) indicates one shared lane-completion event fanned out multiple listeners; which listener chain cancelled this shell is unknowable without live-API data. Recorded rather than guessed.
